full_details: The morning was quiet enough that the house noticed it. You went to St Helen's and stood with the parish, and you came home. At three, with the window open on the close, you wrote three beginnings that were only London, and you struck each one. The fourth you kept. It says you are come safe and the back mends, and that you have counted twenty pound fifteen shillings, and a share of six-and-twenty since. You did not add the share to the coffer. You sealed the sheet for Anne, by Hobbins, on the eleventh. At supper Mistress Ansell said she had heard no walking at all, and she did not trust the quiet. At night you said you would not improve the letter.
one_sentence: You slept till the bells, stood at church, and in the afternoon struck three beginnings and sealed the short letter for the eleventh.
title: Struck three beginnings and sealed the short letter
